en.account.chooseZone: Choose your governorate to see delivery to your area.
en.account.currentPasswordWhy: We ask again so an open session on a shared computer is not enough to take the account over.
en.account.deleteAppleInApp: You sign in with Apple. Delete your account from the NetLet app, where Apple can confirm it's you.
en.account.deleteAppleNote: You sign in with Apple, so Apple confirms it's you. Once the account is deleted, your Apple ID is no longer linked to NetLet.
en.account.deleteBlocked.admin: You're a NetLet administrator. Another administrator has to remove you.
en.account.deleteBlocked.cashOutOwed: NetLet still owes you a points cash-out. You can delete your account once it has been paid.
en.account.deleteBlocked.orderOpen: An order of yours is still on its way. You can delete your account once it has arrived or been cancelled.
en.account.deleteBlocked.returnOpen: A return of yours is still open. You can delete your account once it's finished.
en.account.deleteBlocked.team: You're part of a store or a delivery company on NetLet. Ask them or NetLet to remove you first.
en.account.deleteBlocked.warrantyOpen: A warranty claim of yours is still being answered or repaired. You can delete your account once it's finished.
en.account.deleteBlockedTitle: You can't delete your account yet
en.account.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account just now. Please try again.
en.account.deleteGoogleInApp: You sign in with Google. Delete your account from the NetLet app, where Google can confirm it's you.
en.account.deleteGoogleNote: You sign in with Google, so Google confirms it's you.
en.account.deleteNote: This removes your saved items, wishlists, addresses, points, reviews and standing orders, and signs you out on every device. Your past orders and their invoices are kept, because a shop has to keep its invoices, but they will no longer be linked to an account. It can't be undone.
en.account.deletePasswordNote: Type your password to confirm. We ask again so an open session on a shared computer is not enough to delete somebody's account.
en.account.deletePhoneNote: You sign in with your phone, so we'll text a code to {phone} to confirm it's you.
en.account.deletePoints: Your points balance ({points}) goes with it.
en.account.emailCardNote: Add an email for your receipts and order updates. You'll still sign in with your phone number.
en.account.forgotCurrent: Forgot your current password? Get a code by email
en.account.hint.affiliate: Share products and earn NetLet points
en.account.hint.details: Your name, phone, password and the rest of your details
en.account.hint.frequent: What you buy again and again, back in your cart in one press
en.account.hint.help: Ask NetLet about an order or your account
en.account.hint.history: Products you opened on this device
en.account.hint.offers: Special prices you asked sellers for
en.account.hint.orders: Track, cancel, return and rate what you bought
en.account.hint.returns: Everything you have sent back, and where each one is
en.account.hint.subscriptions: Orders that repeat on a schedule
en.account.hint.wallet: Your NetLet points and how to earn them
en.account.hint.wishlists: Lists to share with family and friends
en.account.loadFailed: Your account could not be loaded just now
en.account.passwordAppleNote: You sign in with Apple, so there is no NetLet password yet. To set one, we'll email you a 6-digit code.
en.account.passwordGoogleNote: You sign in with Google, so there is no NetLet password yet. To set one, we'll email you a 6-digit code.
en.account.passwordNote: Changing this signs nobody out, here or elsewhere.
en.account.passwordPhoneNote: You sign in with your phone number, so there is no NetLet password yet. To set one, we'll email you a 6-digit code.
en.account.preferenceFailed: That preference could not be saved right now.
en.account.pricingUnconfigured: Used to show delivery to your area. Each seller's fee is shown in your bag.
en.account.recoverSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Type it below with a new password.
en.account.sectionFailed: This part of your account could not be loaded.
en.account.sellerNote: The same account sells and shops. Switching does not sign you out, and the portal has a way back.
en.account.signOutBody: Your bag stays where it is. You will need your password to come back.
en.action.device.request: A device asked for admin access
en.action.membership.setPrice: Set the membership price in points
en.action.occasion.setStatus: Occasion published, taken down or hidden
en.action.order.shopperAddress: Delivery address changed by the shopper
en.action.product.setCondition: Product moved between new and refurbished
en.address.badPaci: A PACI number is eight digits.
en.address.badPhone: That is not a Kuwaiti mobile number.
en.address.badPin: That pin is not a place on the map. Drop it again.
en.address.bookNote: Saved here so you can send part of an order somewhere else without typing it again.
en.address.confirmBody: This is where the driver will bring your order. Check it before you save.
en.address.confirmNoPin: No pin on the map. The driver will find your door by the address.
en.address.label: Name for this address
en.address.legacyLine: Saved as one line, kept until you fill in the boxes:
en.address.lineIntro: It goes to the order's main address unless you choose another here. Each address is its own delivery.
en.address.needsAccount: Sign in to send part of an order somewhere else.
en.address.needsGovernorate: Choose the governorate — it decides each seller's delivery fee.
en.address.needsLabel: Give this address a name you will recognise.
en.address.needsLine: Add the block, street and building.
en.address.needsParts: Add the area, block, street and house, which the driver finds the door by.
en.address.paciHint: Eight digits, on the building's blue plate or in Sahel.
en.address.partTooLong: One of the address boxes is longer than it can hold.
en.address.pinOutsideKuwait: That pin is outside Kuwait, and NetLet delivers in Kuwait only.
en.address.removeBody: Anything in your bag going there will go to the order's main address instead. Orders already placed keep the address they were sent to.
en.address.toFreeAt: Add {amount} from {name} going to {label} for free delivery
en.address.tooMany: You have saved as many addresses as we keep.
en.address.unknown: We could not find that address.
en.address.unknownLine: That item is no longer in your bag.
en.address.unknownZone: Choose one of the six governorates.
en.admin.addExisting: Add someone who already has a NetLet account
en.admin.addonNameProblem: Give this extra a name in English or Arabic.
en.admin.addonNamedForYou: Leave the names blank and shoppers see {name}.
en.admin.addonPriceProblem: Enter a price above 0, such as 5.000.
en.admin.addonsFix: Fix the extras marked in red first.
en.admin.addonsNote: What you charge to install this product and to extend its warranty. Each is charged per unit — two fridges need two installations — and only when the shopper chooses it.
en.admin.adminNote: An administrator reaches every vendor, every product, and this page.
en.admin.affiliateStoreRateHint: More than 0 and up to {ceiling}%. Orders already placed keep the rate they were sold at.
en.admin.affiliatesNote: Shoppers who joined to earn NetLet points on the sales their product links bring. Joining is instant, and suspending a member stops their links earning. A sale earns the programme's share of NetLet's commission (Referral rates, on Features) and, on a product its store offers to affiliates, the store's own rate, up to {ceiling}%.
en.admin.applicationAskedMore: Asked the applicant for more documents
en.admin.applicationDocsWaiting: {count} uploaded document(s) still to decide on before this can be approved.
en.admin.applicationNoProposal: No proposal — the standard {standard}% applies unless you change it.
en.admin.applicationProposedFixed: Asks for a fixed {amount} per sale instead of the standard {standard}%.
en.admin.applicationReason: Your note to the applicant (they will read it)
en.admin.applicationsNote: People asking to open a store. Approving one creates the store and makes them its owner — there is no second step.
en.admin.arabicDraftNote: A first draft from the English name, written into the box for you to read and change before saving.
en.admin.arabicDraftUnavailable: No draft right now — please type the Arabic name.
en.admin.auditAllRead: You have read everything sellers changed.
en.admin.auditNote: Every sensitive operation, automatically. Commission edits, approvals, permission changes and price moves — who did it, and what it changed.
en.admin.autoPublishHint: On: the store's products go live when it publishes them. Off: each one waits in the review queue.
en.admin.badReorderPoint: A reorder point is a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
en.admin.badgesEarned: High Rating and Fast Shipping are earned, never awarded. High Rating shows once a store averages {rating} stars over at least {reviews} reviews; Fast Shipping once {share}% of its deliveries in the last {days} days arrived within {hours} hours of the order, from at least {deliveries}.
en.admin.bulkAmount: Units to add to each variant
en.admin.bulkBrandBody: Shoppers then find these products under the brand, in Shop by brand and the Brand filter. A brand already on a product is replaced.
en.admin.bulkBrandHint: As shoppers should read it — the store's own name when it sells only its own brand.
en.admin.bulkBrandInvalid: A brand is 1 to 60 characters, with no phone number, email or link.
en.admin.bulkDepartmentBody: Each product is filed under the department chosen, and shoppers find it on that department's page.
en.admin.bulkPercentHint: 10 raises prices by 10%, −10 lowers them. KWD 10.000 becomes {example}.
en.admin.bulkPercentInvalid: Enter a change between −90% and 1000%, other than 0.
en.admin.bulkPhotosBody: Each photo on another site is fetched once, made smaller (1200 pixels at most) and kept by NetLet, so the cards load quickly on a phone. Its framing does not change. Keep this page open until it finishes.
en.admin.bulkPhotosKept: {count} photos could not be read and stay where they were.
en.admin.bulkPhotosNone: None of the selected products has a photo on another site.
en.admin.bulkRepriceBody: Every variant of each product moves by the same percentage. Was-prices and member prices are left as they are.
en.admin.bulkRestockBody: The units are added to every variant of each product and recorded as received.
en.admin.bulkRestockInvalid: Enter a whole number of units from 1 to 100,000.
en.admin.bulkSquareBody: NetLet AI makes each photo that is not square into a square picture for the cards, widening its background so nothing of the product is cut off. A photo that is already square is left as it is. You can put any photo back afterwards. Keep this page open until it finishes.
en.admin.bulkSquareKept: {count} photos could not be made square and stay as they were.
en.admin.bulkSquareNone: None of the selected products has a photo.
en.admin.bulkSquarePlainNote: Or square them here without NetLet AI: each photo is widened on the colours along its own edges, so nothing of the product is cut. You can put any photo back afterwards.
en.admin.bulkSquareReview: Check each one below, and put back any you would rather keep as it was.
en.admin.bulkStatusBody: Each one is checked as if you changed it alone. Any that cannot change stay as they are and are listed afterwards.
en.admin.bulkTaxBody: What NetLet marks here wins over the shop's setting. Orders already placed do not change.
en.admin.bulkTaxInvalid: Choose taxed, not taxed or the shop's setting.
en.admin.bundleAllAgreed: Every store in this set has agreed.
en.admin.bundleAskedHint: Other stores made these sets with your products. A set goes on sale only once you agree. If its price or items change, you are asked again.
en.admin.bundleAskedNote: {stores} will be asked to agree. The set goes on sale once every store in it has agreed.
en.admin.bundleDeclineBody: {name} will not go on sale. The store that made it reads what you write.
en.admin.bundleDeclineNoteHint: For example, the price it gives your product is too low.
en.admin.bundleNoItems: Nothing in it yet. Find a product below to add it.
en.admin.bundleNotYetAgreed: Not on sale until every store in it agrees.
en.admin.bundleSearchHint: Search by name or product code, then choose the exact option.
en.admin.bundleSearchShopHint: Search the shop by name. Each store whose product you add is asked to agree before the set goes on sale.
en.admin.bundleYourShare: {price} on its own, {share} in this set
en.admin.bundlesNote: Several things sold together for less than the sum of them. The saving comes off every seller in proportion, so nobody funds another shop's promotion, and a set with another store's product goes on sale only once that store agrees. A bundle price is an advertised saving, so every store in it needs a Ministry discount permit on file.
en.admin.cancelLastLineBody: This is the last item on the order, so the order closes. The units go back on the shelf, nothing is collected, and anything the shopper paid with a gift card or points goes back to them. A closed order cannot be restored.
en.admin.cancelLineBody: The units go back on the shelf, the shopper is not charged for it, and the driver collects that much less. You can restore it later while it is still in stock — unless nothing else on the order is still coming, in which case the order closes for good.
en.admin.cannotDemoteSelf: You cannot revoke your own access. Ask another administrator.
en.admin.cardExpiresHint: Optional. The card can be spent until the end of this day, Kuwait time.
en.admin.cardsOff: Gift cards are switched off, so no new ones can be made. Cards already sold stay listed and can still be spent.
en.admin.cashOutsEmpty: Nobody is waiting on a cash-out.
en.admin.cashOutsNote: Balances shoppers have asked for in cash. The points are already off their balance; this is the bank transfer.
en.admin.claimsConfirmBody: A decision is final. A parcel can be claimed again with new evidence, but this claim cannot be reopened.
en.admin.claimsLedger: What each company owes for damage
en.admin.claimsNoResponse: The company has not answered yet.
en.admin.claimsNote: Parcels that arrived damaged, charged to the company that carried them. Sellers file from the order, companies answer, NetLet decides.
en.admin.codeEditing: Editing {code}. Saving changes it for every shopper from now on; uses so far are kept.
en.admin.codeEndsHint: The code works until the end of this day, Kuwait time.
en.admin.codeFundedNetlet: NetLet pays, and the store is paid in full
en.admin.codeFundedStore: The store pays, out of its earnings
en.admin.codeProductsHint: Tick each product the code takes money off. It comes off that product's line alone.
en.admin.codeStoreNote: Your codes take money off your own products only, typed by the shopper on that product at checkout. The discount comes out of your earnings, and NetLet's commission is taken on what the shopper pays. They work while your discount permit is valid.
en.admin.collectedAlready: That was already recorded, or it is not a cash order.
en.admin.collectedBody: This marks the order paid, issues its invoice, and from then on its items can no longer be cancelled — only refunded.
en.admin.collectedTitle: Record the cash for {reference} as collected?
en.admin.couriersNote: Who NetLet works with, and who has a login. A suspended company keeps the parcels it carried and stops being one work can be given to.
en.admin.deleteBlockedAd: A paid placement for this product is running or booked. Cancel it under Placements first.
en.admin.deleteBlockedNetlet: NetLet is holding or expecting stock of this product. Ask for it back under Fulfilled by NetLet first.
en.admin.deleteBlockedSponsor: This product has a sponsorship request still open. Withdraw it under Sponsored products first.
en.admin.deleteBody: This removes the product, its variants, photos and stock history for good. Orders already placed keep their own copy.
en.admin.deleteChecking: Checking what it is connected to…
en.admin.deleteOpenOrders: {count} orders with it still need sending. They keep their copy of the product and stay on Orders.
en.admin.deleteSectionNote: Removes it for good, with its variants, photos and stock history. To take it out of the shop and keep it, move it to draft.
en.admin.deleteTypeName: To confirm, type the product's name
en.admin.deleteUnpublishInstead: To take it out of the shop and keep it, move it to draft instead.
en.admin.deliveryCourierHint: Only companies NetLet works with are listed.
en.admin.deliveryCourierNone: Not on NetLet — the store delivers itself
en.admin.deliveryModeNetletNote: Parcels go on NetLet's dispatch board, and NetLet gives each to a delivery company.
en.admin.deliveryModeOwnNote: If that company is on NetLet, its parcels go straight to its board. If not, the store marks them shipped and delivered itself.
en.admin.discountLicenceHint: Kuwaiti law requires a Ministry of Commerce discount permit before a shop may advertise a saving. Without a valid one, this store's products still sell at their price but stop showing a discount.
en.admin.dispatchNote: Every parcel waiting for a driver, with what it takes to carry it. A parcel is one seller's goods going to one door — an order can be several.
en.admin.emailTaken: That email already has an account.
en.admin.fieldDeliveryFlatHint: Left blank, this store delivers free.
en.admin.fieldDeliveryFreeOverHint: Measured against this store's own goods, never the whole basket.
en.admin.fieldDeliveryProviderHint: Recorded and shown to shoppers. NetLet does not connect to any carrier, so nothing here is tracked.
en.admin.fieldDescriptionArHint: Shown on the Arabic page. Left empty, the Arabic page shows the description above.
en.admin.fieldFastFeeHint: Charged for each fast parcel, whatever it holds. Blank offers no fast option.
en.admin.financeEmpty: No completed sales yet. NetLet cannot take a payment until a payment provider is connected, so there is nothing to report — this panel fills in on its own once orders start completing.
en.admin.financeMonthNote: Months are counted in UTC. Kuwait is UTC+3, so a sale just after midnight falls in the previous month here.
en.admin.financeNote: Every figure here is read from what each order froze at the moment of sale. Nothing is recomputed against today's rates.
en.admin.financeTruncated: Showing the most recent lines only. These totals are incomplete.
en.admin.flagBannedClaim: A claim the shop cannot stand behind
en.admin.flagContactInText: Contact details in the listing — this takes the buyer off NetLet
en.admin.flagModelAsk: Ask NetLet AI to read it
en.admin.flagModelNothing: NetLet AI found nothing to raise.
en.admin.flagZeroPrice: A variant is priced at nothing — publishing will be refused
en.admin.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
en.admin.genApplied: Draft filled in. Read each field before you create the product.
en.admin.genDraftNote: Written by AI from your notes and photos, and it can be wrong. Check every fact before you use it.
en.admin.genErrorBusy: That is a lot of drafts in a minute. Try again shortly.
en.admin.genErrorFailed: No draft came back this time. Try again in a moment, or add more detail.
en.admin.genErrorRefused: AI would not draft this one. Check the notes and try again.
en.admin.genErrorTooLarge: That is too much to send at once. Shorten the notes or use fewer photos.
en.admin.genIntro: Write what you know and add a photo or two. AI drafts the name in English and Arabic, both descriptions, the department, its specifications and tags — and nothing goes into the form until you choose.
en.admin.genMissing: Not in your notes or photos: {fields}.
en.admin.genNeedInput: Write a few notes or upload a photo first.
en.admin.genNotesHint: The maker, the model, sizes, colours, what is in the box. The price and the stock are yours to set below.
en.admin.genNotesPlaceholder: Samsung Galaxy A55, 256 GB, 8 GB memory, navy, charger and case in the box, one-year warranty
en.admin.genPhotosHint: The first three photos uploaded here or in step 2. A photo added by its web address is not sent.
en.admin.genPhotosNone: None yet — notes alone work too.
en.admin.genSeoNote: For reference only: NetLet does not keep a separate search title or description yet, so search results show the product's name and description.
en.admin.genUseNote: Fills the names, descriptions, department, specifications and tags below; you can change any of them before you create the product.
en.admin.healthNote: Every figure below is one you can check. Nothing here is a judgement you cannot reproduce.
en.admin.ibanReadAs: Saved as {iban}: a Kuwaiti bank code is four letters.
en.admin.imagesHint: The first one is what shoppers see on the card
en.admin.importDrafts: Everything arrives as a draft. Publishing is its own decision — it needs a price, and a Ministry permit behind any advertised saving.
en.admin.importFileHint: Use the template's columns. The file is read in your browser; nothing is sent until you press Create.
en.admin.importFiling: Asking NetLet AI to file the rows with no department…
en.admin.importFixPhotos: Fix the photos as they come in ({count})
en.admin.importFixPhotosHint: Each photo is fetched through NetLet, trimmed, squared and levelled like an upload, and kept here. A photo that cannot be read keeps its address.
en.admin.importGuessed: {count} rows left the category blank, so we filled it from the product name. Check them below — a blank column is easy to correct and a wrong department is hard to find.
en.admin.importModelFiled: NetLet AI filed {count} of them that the words alone could not place.
en.admin.importNote: Export your catalogue as CSV — Excel and Google Sheets both write it from Save As. Nothing is created until you have seen what we read.
en.admin.importPhotosKept: Photos that could not be fixed and keep their addresses: {count}.
en.admin.importPhotosStopped: The hour's limit for fetching photos was reached. Photos left as addresses: {count}.
en.admin.importPreview: What we read from your file
en.admin.importStoreNeeded: Choose the store first. Every row in the file goes to the one store chosen here.
en.admin.importTooMany: That is more than {limit} rows. Split the file and upload it in parts.
en.admin.installNote: A fee for installing or setting it up at the shopper's address.
en.admin.invalidGovernorate: Choose one of the six governorates.
en.admin.invalidIban: That IBAN's check digits do not add up.
en.admin.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 30, with at most two decimals.
en.admin.invoicesNoMatch: Nothing matches that number or reference.
en.admin.invoicesNone: No invoices yet. One is issued the moment an order's cash is recorded as collected.
en.admin.invoicesNote: Every invoice and credit note NetLet has issued. An invoice is issued when an order's money is collected and never edited afterwards; a refund adds a credit note against it.
en.admin.invoicesSearch: Find by invoice number or order reference
en.admin.lastAdmin: This is the only administrator. Promote somebody else first.
en.admin.lastOwner: This is the store's only owner. Make somebody else an owner first, so the store is never left without anyone who can run its team.
en.admin.linkedProducts: Showing only the products named in your link ({count}).
en.admin.lowStockNote: Ranked by how far each is below its own reorder point, so the urgent one is first.
en.admin.lowStockTitle: Running low and out of stock
en.admin.makeAdminBody: They will reach every store, every product, commission, payouts and this page — everything you can. Only do this for somebody who runs NetLet.
en.admin.markPaidBody: Do this once the bank transfer has gone out. It is recorded against this cash-out and cannot be undone from here.
en.admin.mediaPosterHint: The still shown before the video plays. Left empty, the player shows its own first frame.
en.admin.moveBlockedAd: A paid placement for this product is running or booked, and it is charged to the store that booked it. Cancel it under Placements first.
en.admin.moveBlockedNetlet: NetLet is holding or expecting this store's stock of the product. Return it to the store first, under Fulfilled by NetLet.
en.admin.moveBlockedOffer: A shopper has asked this store for a price on it, or holds one the store agreed. Answer or let it lapse first, so the new store is not held to another store's price.
en.admin.moveBlockedSponsor: This product has a sponsorship request still open. It has to be withdrawn, declined or paid for under Sponsored products first.
en.admin.moveBody: Its stock, photos, reviews and saved hearts go with it. Orders already placed stay with {from}, which sold them. From now on {store}'s commission rate and discount permit apply to it.
en.admin.moveSameStore: It already belongs to that store.
en.admin.movedBundles: {count} of the old store's bundles that included it were taken off the shop.
en.admin.needVendorFirst: There is no vendor to add a product to. Approve or create one first.
en.admin.needsWarranty: An electronics product needs its warranty stated before it goes on sale — add a Warranty row under Specifications ("12 months", or "No warranty").
en.admin.newDescriptionHint: What it is, what it is made of, what comes in the box. Line breaks are kept.
en.admin.newDraftNote: A draft is saved but not in the shop. You can publish it from its page.
en.admin.newIntro: Start with what a shopper needs to decide. Sizes, specifications and extras can be added once it is created.
en.admin.newPhotoAdded: Photo added. It is saved with the product when you create it.
en.admin.newPhotoUrl: Paste a full web address, starting with {scheme}.
en.admin.newPhotosHint: The first photo is the one on the card. Square photos on a plain background work best.
en.admin.newPricePositive: The price has to be more than zero.
en.admin.newSearchAddDescription: Add a description so a search result has something to say about it.
en.admin.newSearchCut: Search results will cut this short.
en.admin.newSearchEmpty: Type the product's name to see how its search result will read.
en.admin.newSearchHint: Search engines show the product's name and the start of its description. This is how the result will read.
en.admin.newSkuHint: Your own code for it. Each one is used once across your shop.
en.admin.newSpecsHint: From the AI draft. Change or remove any of them; the rest of the specifications are in the editor once the product is created.
en.admin.newStockHint: How many you have now. Later changes are recorded with a reason on the product's page.
en.admin.newStockShape: Enter a whole number of items.
en.admin.newStoreHint: The store that sells it. Its commission rate, delivery fee and discount permit apply to the product.
en.admin.newStoreIntro: Opens the store and, if you fill in the owner below, their login — in one step.
en.admin.newTitleArRequired: Give the Arabic name — it is what the Arabic shop shows.
en.admin.newTitleHint: What a shopper would type to find it: the brand, the product and the one detail that matters.
en.admin.newTooLong: That is longer than this field holds.
en.admin.newWarrantyHint: As you would say it to the buyer. Shown on the product page and attributed to your store.
en.admin.newWarrantyRequired: State the warranty — an electronics product cannot go on sale without one ("No warranty" is an answer).
en.admin.newWasHigher: The was-price has to be higher than the price.
en.admin.newWasHint: Shown as a saving only while the store has a valid discount permit. Without one, the product sells at its price.
en.admin.noAccess: You do not have an admin account.
en.admin.noAccessNote: This account is not a member of any vendor. If that is wrong, ask your vendor's owner to add you.
en.admin.noEmailToReset: This account signs in with a phone number, so there is no email to send a link to.
en.admin.noImages: No images yet. A product without a photo is rarely bought.
en.admin.noMembers: Nobody else is in this vendor yet.
en.admin.noProductsNote: Add your first product and it will appear here.
en.admin.noStoreMembers: Nobody can sign in for this store yet.
en.admin.noSuchAccount: No account uses that address. They need to register first.
en.admin.offerHiddenExpired: The was-price is not shown in the shop, because this store's discount permit has expired. The product sells at its price, and the saving appears again once the permit is renewed.
en.admin.offerHiddenMissing: The was-price is not shown in the shop, because this store has no discount permit recorded. The product sells at its price, and the saving appears once a valid permit is recorded.
en.admin.offersAnswerNote: A line back to the shopper (optional)
en.admin.offersNote: Shoppers asking for a special price on something you sell. What you quote is theirs alone — it is never advertised, so it needs no discount permit.
en.admin.offersStoreOpen: Take price requests for this store
en.admin.offersStoreOpenNote: Off by default. A shop that never answers is worse than no button at all.
en.admin.optionDuplicate: Each option name can be used once on a variant.
en.admin.optionHalf: Give every option both a name and a value.
en.admin.optionTooLong: Keep a name under 60 characters and a value under 120.
en.admin.orderGone: That order is no longer available.
en.admin.ordersNote: Every order holding something of yours. Move each line along as it is packed, sent and delivered — delivery is what opens a review and starts the payout clock.
en.admin.otherNote: Anything else you offer with this product, such as gift wrapping.
en.admin.overviewIntro: What is waiting for you, and how the shop stands.
en.admin.ownerAccountNote: Leave blank to open the store now and attach its owner later.
en.admin.ownerPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Hand it over and ask them to change it.
en.admin.ownerStays: The shop's owner is always an administrator.
en.admin.payoutCancelBody: Only if the bank did not make it. The money goes back into the store's next payout.
en.admin.payoutFilesNote: Upload a file to your bank's bulk payment service. Downloading it again gives the same file with the same message id, so the bank refuses a second upload of it. ISO 20022 is the format most banks take for bulk transfers; the CSV is for a bank with its own spreadsheet template.
en.admin.payoutMarkFileBody: Only once the bank has made them. Bank reference: {reference}.

en.features.adsOff: No new placements can be booked. Placements already booked run out their days, keep their place on the shelf and are charged for the days they run.
en.features.affiliatesOff: Nobody new can apply, and new orders are not attributed to a link. Orders already attributed are still paid, and earned balances can still be paid out.
en.features.aiOff: Stops every request to an AI model: the shop assistant, drafting products, smarter search, photo search, the AI ordering of recommendations, the AI pass in the review queue and drafted support replies. Each falls back to its ordinary behaviour.
en.features.appBannerOff: The home page does not invite shoppers to the app.
en.features.articlesOff: The home page's guides are not shown. They stay on the guides page.
en.features.assistantOff: The chat button, the “Ask about this product” panel and the help page's question box disappear.
en.features.boughtTogetherOff: The “often bought together” rail disappears from product pages.
en.features.cashOnDeliveryOff: Shoppers cannot pay cash at the door at any store. Orders already placed in cash are still collected.
en.features.damageClaimsOff: Nobody can file a new damage claim. Open claims can still be answered and decided.
en.features.deliveryRatingsOff: Shoppers can no longer rate a delivery. Ratings already given stay visible.
en.features.fulfilmentOff: Sellers cannot announce new shipments. What is already on its way is still counted in, what NetLet holds still sells, and sold lines are still picked and packed.
en.features.giftCardsOff: No new gift cards can be issued. Cards already issued stay spendable.
en.features.membershipOff: No new memberships can be granted. Members keep every benefit until their membership runs out.
en.features.note: Every advanced feature can be turned off for the whole shop. Off stops anything new from starting and leaves what is already in motion to finish — an open return is still refunded, an agreed price is still honoured. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
en.features.off: This is switched off on NetLet for now.
en.features.photoSearchOff: The camera is not shown in the search box, and no photo is sent to a model.
en.features.priceOffersOff: Shoppers can no longer ask a seller for a price. Sellers can still answer open requests, and prices already agreed are still honoured at checkout.
en.features.recommendationsOff: The personal recommendation rail disappears from the home page.
en.features.returnsOff: Shoppers can no longer start a return from their orders. Returns already requested carry on to collection and refund.
en.features.someone: an account that no longer exists
en.features.subscriptionsOff: Nobody can start a new standing order. Those already standing keep running on their schedule, and shoppers can still skip, pause or stop them.
en.features.taxAllProductsOff: Only the products you mark as taxed on the products list are taxed. A product marked either way keeps its mark.
en.features.taxConfirmOnBody: Every order from now adds {rate} on the taxed products, as a Tax line under delivery. Orders already placed do not change.
en.features.taxOff: No tax is added to any order. An order already placed with tax keeps it.
en.features.testPaymentsOff: No order page offers paying online on NetLet's test page. While it is on, a shopper can mark a cash order paid online without paying, so keep it for trying the flow.
en.features.tryOnOff: No product page offers to show a shopper wearing the item, and no shopper's photo is sent to a model.
en.features.voiceSearchOff: The microphone is not shown in the search box.
en.features.why.aiOff: Not showing: "AI features" is switched off on this page.
en.features.why.noGateway: Not showing: the AI gateway is not connected (AI_GATEWAY_URL and AI_GATEWAY_SECRET). Add both in the deployment's settings.
en.features.why.noGuides: Nothing to show yet: no guide for shoppers is published. Write one under Guides.
en.features.why.noPairs: Not showing yet: it appears on a product once an order has held it with something else.
en.features.why.recommendationsWhere: Shown on the Saved page to a signed-in shopper, once they have saved, bagged or bought enough to go on.
en.features.why.taxNoneMarked: Only marked products are taxed, and none is marked yet.
en.features.why.taxNotReady: Waiting for migration 0087: until it is pasted, no tax is added.
en.features.why.taxOff: Changes nothing while "Tax at checkout" is off.
en.features.why.tryOnWhere: Offered on clothing, shoes and accessories in the Style department, to signed-in shoppers.
en.features.why.voiceBrowser: Shown in browsers that can listen — Chrome, Edge and Safari; absent elsewhere.
en.features.wishlistsOff: Shoppers can no longer make or add to gift lists, and shared links and the phone lookup stop working. Owners can still read their lists.

en.fulfilment.notYourVariant: That item is not one of your store's.
en.fulfilment.operatorNote: NetLet's own floor: count sellers' shipments in, pick and pack what sold, and send stock back. Delivery companies collect packed parcels from the centre through the dispatch board.
en.fulfilment.otherCentre: That item is already held at another centre. One item is held in one place.
en.fulfilment.packRateFor: Packing rate per unit at {centre}, in KWD
en.fulfilment.packedToast: {count} lines packed and ready to collect.
en.fulfilment.pickNote: Lines sold from a NetLet centre, oldest order first. Marking an order packed tells the dispatch board it is ready to collect.
en.fulfilment.pickTruncated: Showing the oldest orders only. Pack these and the rest will appear.
en.fulfilment.preorderVariant: That item has a pre-order allowance. Set it to zero before sending stock to NetLet.
en.fulfilment.recordCountBody: The counted units go onto NetLet's shelf and the shop sells them from there. An item NetLet did not hold before is handed over: the shop stops selling the seller's own stock of it.
en.fulfilment.sellerNote: Send stock to a NetLet fulfilment centre and NetLet holds it, picks it and packs it when it sells. Once NetLet counts a shipment in, the shop sells from NetLet's shelf for that item, and only NetLet's counts change it.
en.fulfilment.sendBackBody: {count} units leave NetLet's shelf and the item goes back to the seller's own stock, at zero until they count it. Lines already sold from NetLet stay NetLet's to pack.
en.fulfilment.sendNote: Say what you are sending. Nothing changes in the shop until NetLet counts it in, and what NetLet counts is what is recorded.
en.fulfilment.title: Fulfilled by NetLet
en.fulfilment.tooManyLines: That is too many items for one shipment. Split it in two.
en.gift.claimed_toast: Marked. It is hidden from other visitors for two weeks.
en.gift.empty: That gift card has nothing left on it.
en.gift.emptyList: There is nothing on this list yet.
en.gift.fromIntro: The list's owner sees who a gift is from only once it arrives.
en.gift.fromIntroNamed: {name} sees who a gift is from only once it arrives.
en.gift.fromNameNote: They see the name below when it arrives.
en.gift.fromSignIn: Sign in to show your name
en.gift.fromSignedOut: Signed out, a gift stays anonymous: they see “From someone”.
en.gift.heading: Buy someone a gift
en.gift.intro: Enter their mobile number, or the name they show on their list, to see any list they have published.
en.gift.linkGone: This list is no longer shared at this link.
en.gift.linkGoneNote: Its owner may have made it private, which also gives it a new link. Ask them for the new one, or find it by their number.
en.gift.loadFailed: This list could not be loaded just now.
en.gift.lookupInvalid: Enter a Kuwait mobile number, or at least two letters of their name.
en.gift.none: No published list for that number or name.
en.gift.noneNote: They may not have published one, may use a different number here, or may show no name on it. Ask them for the link instead.
en.gift.secret: They cannot see who took what — it stays a surprise.
en.gift.secretUntilArrival: They can't see what's been taken. Once a gift arrives, they see who it's from, or “someone”.
en.gift.signInToRelease: Signed in, you can change your mind about something you choose. Signed out, it stays held for you for two weeks.
en.gift.switchedOff: Gift lists are switched off on NetLet for now.
en.gift.title: Find a wishlist
en.gift.unknown: We do not recognise that gift card.
en.grants.isAdmin: An administrator already holds every permission.
en.grants.notGrantable: That permission cannot be granted on its own.
en.grants.setCommissionNote: Reaches the commission desk and nothing else an administrator can do. Who granted it is recorded on every change.
en.guides.adminEmptyNote: Start one from a topic, such as "How to return an item".
en.guides.adminIntro: How-to guides for shoppers and sellers. Draft one with AI or write it yourself; nobody sees it until you publish it.
en.guides.badPicture: A step's picture must be one uploaded to NetLet.
en.guides.contactDetails: Take out the phone number, email or link: a guide sends people to NetLet, not off it.
en.guides.deleteBody: The guide and its steps are deleted for good.
en.guides.deleteBodyPublished: The guide is taken off the shop and deleted for good. Links to it will stop working.
en.guides.draftNote: Name the topic and the model writes the steps in both languages, from the help page's answers. Read and correct them: nothing is saved until you press Save.
en.guides.drawnAlt: The picture the model drew for this step
en.guides.drawnNote: Drawn by AI from this step's words. Use it only if it shows the step truthfully.
en.guides.emptyNote: Until there are, the help page answers the common questions.
en.guides.intro: Step-by-step help with shopping and selling on NetLet, with a picture for each step.
en.guides.loadFailed: Guides could not be loaded just now
en.guides.needTitle: Give the guide a title in English and in Arabic.
en.guides.notFoundNote: It may have been taken down or renamed. Every published guide is on the guides page.
en.guides.oneLoadFailed: This guide could not be loaded just now
en.guides.pictureAdded: Picture added. Save the guide to keep it.
en.guides.publishNote: A published guide is on /guides, on the help page, and — for shoppers — on the home page.
en.guides.publishedNote: This guide is on the shop. Saving a change publishes it at once; taking it down keeps it here as a draft.
en.guides.replaceBody: The draft will replace the title, the summary and every step in the form. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
en.guides.saveFirst: Save the guide first; then it can be published.
en.guides.stepIncomplete: Every step needs a title and words, in English and in Arabic.
en.guides.title: Guides
en.guides.topicHint: For example: how to track an order, or how to add a product.
en.guides.unpublishedNow: Guide taken down. It is a draft again.
en.haptics.note: The small tap you feel when you press a button, add to your cart or drop a pin. Kept on this device.
en.haptics.title: Haptic feedback
en.header.aiUnavailable: NetLet AI isn't available right now. The standard results below still work.
en.header.noMatchYet: No product matches that yet. See all results, or try another word.
en.header.signInDisabled: Sign-in is disabled in this static preview.
en.header.signInDisabledNote: Your cart and saved items still work — they are kept in this browser.
en.header.signedOut: You are signed out of NetLet.
en.help.a.areas: To all six governorates of Kuwait.
en.help.a.deliveryCost: Each seller sets their own delivery charge, and many deliver free over an amount. Your cart shows each seller's charge and how much more would make it free.
en.help.a.deliveryWhen: Each product shows its seller's delivery time and a day to expect it by. Friday and Saturday are not counted as working days.
en.help.a.language: Use the language button in the header. Signed in, your choice follows you to other devices.
en.help.a.password: Choose Sign in, then Forgot your password?, and enter your email. We send a 6-digit code: type it with a new password and you are signed in. Signed in already? Your profile has the same.
en.help.a.pay: Cash on delivery: you pay the driver when your order arrives. Card payments are not available yet. A seller may limit how large a cash order can be, and checkout says so if one does.
en.help.a.refund: Once the seller has the item back, the way you paid. For an exchange with none left, you are refunded instead.
en.help.a.returns: Within {days} days of delivery, open the order, tick the item's circle and press Return. Damaged, faulty and wrong items are approved straight away.
en.help.a.sell: Apply on the Sell with us page. NetLet checks the application before your store opens, and the standard commission is shown there before you apply.
en.help.a.where: Your orders, in your account, show where each item is. Without signing in, look it up on this page with the order number and the email you ordered with. While a driver shares their location, the order shows it on a map.
en.help.account.say: Most account changes are a press away: your name, phone and password, and deleting the account, are under Your profile, what NetLet tells you under Notification settings, and where things go under Addresses.
en.help.askAnswerNote: Written by a model from this page's answers. Check anything important with a person.
en.help.askContact: Leave out the {kind} and ask again: this question goes to a model, and your details have no business there.
en.help.askNote: Answered by a model from the answers on this page only, never from your account. Please leave out phone numbers and emails.
en.help.contactMessageNote: Sign in to write to us. A person reads every message.
en.help.damaged.return: Sorry it arrived like that. A damaged or faulty item is approved at once: choose a refund or the same item again, and the driver collects {item}.
en.help.exchange.how: The same item is sent again and the driver collects {item}. If the store has none left, it becomes a refund.
en.help.exchange.size: For another size or colour, return it for a refund and order the one you want.
en.help.intro: Answers to what people ask most, where your order is, and how to reach a person.
en.help.issuesIntro: Choose what happened. You get an answer from your order straight away, and a person is one press away.
en.help.issuesTitle: What do you need help with?
en.help.item.cancelled: {item} was cancelled, so nothing was charged for it.
en.help.item.notArrived: {item} has not reached you yet, and tracking shows where it is.
en.help.item.notArrivedCancel: {item} has not reached you yet. No driver has it, so you can cancel it instead of returning it.
en.help.item.returnDone: {item} has already been refunded or exchanged.
en.help.item.returnOpen: A return is already open on {item}. Your returns show where it stands.
en.help.item.warrantyCovers: The store's warranty still covers it: tell them what is wrong.
en.help.item.windowClosed: The {days}-day return window for {item} has closed.
en.help.late.canCancel: Nothing has left the store yet, so you can still cancel the order.
en.help.late.canCancelItem: No driver has it yet, so you can still cancel it.
en.help.late.cancelled: This order was cancelled, so nothing more is coming.
en.help.late.chase: A person at NetLet can chase the store for you.
en.help.late.delivered: Everything in this order is marked delivered. If a parcel did not reach you, a person at NetLet will look into it with the store.
en.help.late.late: This is later than the store's estimate of {date}. Sorry about that.
en.help.late.madeToOrder: It is made to order, so the store gave no fixed date.
en.help.late.noEstimate: The store gave no estimate for this one.
en.help.late.preorder: It is a pre-order, expected from {date}.
en.help.late.preorderOpen: It is a pre-order and ships as soon as it arrives.
en.help.late.withDriver: Part of it is with the driver now, and tracking shows where.
en.help.lookupNone: No order matches that number and email. Check both and try again.
en.help.lookupNote: The order number is in your confirmation, like NL-20261012-ABCDE.
en.help.lookupSignedIn: Your orders are in your account.
en.help.lookupTooMany: Too many tries for one hour. Try again later, or message a person.
en.help.offer.buyAgainBody: Puts it back in your cart at today's price. Nothing is ordered until you check out.
en.help.offer.cancelItemBody: The driver will collect {owed} instead of {was}.
en.help.offer.cancelOrderBody: Everything is cancelled before a driver has it, and nothing is collected.
en.help.offer.exchangeBody: The driver collects it and brings the same item again.
en.help.offer.note: Nothing happens until you press Confirm.
en.help.offer.returnBody: The driver collects it, and the refund is paid once the store has it.
en.help.payment.cancelled: This order was cancelled, so nothing is owed on it.
en.help.payment.cod: You pay {owed} in cash to the driver when it arrives. Nothing is charged before then, and nobody from NetLet asks for card details.
en.help.payment.paid: This order is paid. A refund for a return is paid back once the store has the item.
en.help.payment.person: If you were asked for a different amount, or for money any other way, a person at NetLet will sort it out.
en.help.pickItem: Choose the item this is about.
en.help.pickOrder: Choose the order this is about.
en.help.q.language: How do I switch to Arabic or English?
en.help.q.refund: When do I get my money back?
en.help.q.sell: How do I sell on NetLet?
en.help.result.approved: Done: approved at once. The driver will collect it.
en.help.result.buyAgain: Done: it is in your cart.
en.help.result.waiting: Sent. The store answers, and you are told.
en.help.return.how: Choose why you are sending {item} back. A fault, a wrong item and a change of mind are approved at once (groceries are not taken back for a change of mind), and the refund is paid once the store has it.
en.help.signInForOrders: Sign in to get help with one of your orders.
en.help.title: Help
en.help.warranty.file: Tell the store what stopped working on {item}, with a photo or two, and they answer with a repair, a replacement or a refund.
en.help.warranty.none: The store records no warranty for {item}, and the return window has closed. A person at NetLet will look at it with the store.
en.help.warranty.open: A warranty claim is already open on {item}; where it stands is shown under the item.
en.help.warranty.returnFirst: {item} is still inside the return window, so a return is quicker: a fault is approved at once. Or claim the store's warranty instead.
en.help.warranty.returnInstead: The store records no warranty for {item}, but it is still inside the return window, and a fault is approved at once.
en.help.wrong.missing: If something is missing from the parcel, a person at NetLet checks it with the store.
en.help.wrong.return: Received something else, or not as described? Sending {item} back is approved at once, for a refund or the right item again.
en.history.clearBody: Every product you opened on this device leaves the list and Previously viewed.
en.history.deleteAsk: Remove the chosen products from your history?
en.history.deleteBody: They leave this list and Previously viewed on this device.
en.history.empty: Nothing yet. Products you open appear here.
en.history.intro: The products you opened on this device, newest first. It is kept here for {days} days, never on NetLet's servers.
en.history.title: Browsing history
en.home.appNote: Save discoveries and return to your cart whenever you are ready.
en.home.appSoon: The NetLet app isn't available to download yet.
en.home.catalogSlow: Products could not be loaded just now.
en.home.heading: NetLet
en.home.refreshNote: Try again in a moment to see the latest products.
en.howTo.basics.arabic: Add its Arabic name, or let NetLet AI suggest one for you to check.
en.howTo.basics.department: Choose its department, so shoppers find it there.
en.howTo.basics.name: Name it the way a shopper would search for it.
en.howTo.basics.title: Name and department
en.howTo.description.tags: Tags help shoppers find it: a material, a room, an occasion.
en.howTo.description.title: Description and tags
en.howTo.description.write: Write short paragraphs. Lines that start with a dash become a list.
en.howTo.example: An example. Nothing here is saved.
en.howTo.extras.install: If you install it, charge for installing it at the shopper's address.
en.howTo.extras.title: Warranty and installation
en.howTo.extras.warranty: Offer longer warranty plans. A shopper picks one at most.
en.howTo.generate.notes: Write what you know about it, and add a photo if you have one.
en.howTo.generate.press: Press “{button}”. A draft comes back for you to read first.
en.howTo.generate.title: Draft a listing with AI
en.howTo.generate.use: “{button}” fills in the form. Nothing is saved until you create the product.
en.howTo.import.check: Choose the file. NetLet checks every row and files each product in a department.
en.howTo.import.create: Create them all at once. They arrive as drafts for you to check and publish.
en.howTo.import.template: Download the template, then fill in one row per product.
en.howTo.import.title: Import a spreadsheet
en.howTo.photos.add: Add up to {max} photos. The first one is the cover shoppers see.
en.howTo.photos.fixList: trimmed the empty border, centred on a square, brightened
en.howTo.photos.fixed: NetLet fixes each photo for you: empty edges trimmed, centred and brightened.
en.howTo.photos.square: Or let NetLet AI make it square on white, then check the product still looks the same.
en.howTo.photos.title: Photos and photo fixes
en.howTo.price.price: Type the price in dinars, with three decimals.
en.howTo.price.stock: Say how many you have. The shop stops selling it at zero.
en.howTo.price.title: Price and stock
en.howTo.price.was: A was-price shows shoppers what they save, while your store's discount permit is valid.
en.howTo.publish.draft: Not ready yet? “{button}” keeps it off the shop until you publish it.
en.howTo.publish.later: Sizes, colours and extras are added on the product's page once it is created.
en.howTo.publish.now: “{button}” puts it on the shop at once.
en.howTo.publish.review: If NetLet reviews your store's products, it waits in review and goes live once approved.
en.howTo.publish.title: Create and publish
en.howTo.sample.description:
Solid brass, 45 cm tall.
- Warm white bulb included
- Fabric shade
en.howTo.sample.notes: Brass lamp, 45 cm tall, warm white bulb included
en.howTo.sample.snippet: Solid brass, 45 cm tall, with a warm white bulb and a fabric shade.
en.howTo.sample.title: Brass table lamp
en.howTo.search.card: And this is its card, as shoppers see it on NetLet.
en.howTo.search.engine: This is how the product shows in a search engine: its name first, then its description.
en.howTo.search.title: How it shows in search
en.howTo.variants.each: Each size or colour is a variant, with its own price and stock.
en.howTo.variants.options: Give each variant its options, such as Colour: Black. Shoppers then pick it from buttons.
en.howTo.variants.title: Sizes, colours and options
en.invoice.footer: Amounts in Kuwaiti dinar, to three decimal places. This document is kept unchanged once issued; any correction is a separate credit note.
en.invoice.notFound: There is no invoice with that number on your account.
en.invoice.reasonExchangeRefund: Exchange refunded: the replacement was out of stock
en.invoice.signIn: Sign in on your account page to see your invoices.
en.invoice.title: Invoice
en.invoice.verifyCorrected: A later credit note corrects part of this invoice.
en.invoice.verifyHow: Scan the code, or open this address and compare what it shows with the paper:
en.invoice.verifyNo: NetLet cannot confirm this document. The number or the code does not match anything NetLet issued.
en.invoice.verifyQrAlt: QR code linking to the check for this document
en.invoice.verifyYes: This is a genuine NetLet invoice. Compare these details with the paper.
en.invoice.verifyYesCredit: This is a genuine NetLet credit note. Compare these details with the paper.
en.ios.biometric.cardOff: Sign in on this iPhone with {kind} instead of a password or a code.
en.ios.biometric.cardOn: On for this iPhone. NetLet never sees your face: your iPhone checks it and answers yes or no.
en.ios.biometric.changed: {kind} changed on this iPhone since it was set up, so it was turned off for NetLet. Sign in with your password or a code, then turn it on again.
en.ios.biometric.methodNote: Your iPhone checks it's you, so there's nothing to type.
en.ios.biometric.notEnrolled: Set up {kind} in your iPhone's Settings first.
en.ios.biometric.offerBody: Next time, sign in to this account on this iPhone with {kind} instead of a password or a code.
en.ios.biometric.setUpAgainNote: Added a face or a fingerprint in your iPhone's Settings, for you or someone else? Set up again so NetLet uses what this iPhone holds now.
en.ios.biometric.unavailable: This iPhone can't use {kind} for NetLet.
en.ios.error.network: NetLet could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
en.ios.error.notFound: That could not be found. It may have been removed.
en.ios.error.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
en.ios.error.timedOut: NetLet took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
en.ios.error.tooMany: That is a lot of requests. Wait a minute and try again.
en.ios.error.update: This version of the app could not read NetLet's answer. Update the app from the App Store.
en.ios.home.earlierShelf: NetLet can't be reached just now, so this is what it showed earlier today.
en.ios.invite.bad: That doesn't look like an invitation code. Check it, or leave the box empty.
en.ios.invite.label: Invitation code
en.ios.permission.camera: Take a photo of a product to search for it on NetLet (sent only when you press search), or, when you deliver for NetLet, scan a shopper's code at the door.
en.ios.permission.faceId: Sign in to NetLet with Face ID instead of a password or a code. Your face never leaves your iPhone.
en.ios.permission.location: NetLet uses your location only to move the map to where you are, so you can pin your door for the driver.
en.ios.permission.microphone: NetLet listens only while you hold a search or a question open, so you can say it instead of typing.
en.ios.permission.speech: Your words are turned into text by Apple's speech recognition and written into the box for you to check before anything is sent.
en.ios.rate.note: Tell others what you think on the App Store.
en.ios.rate.testflight: Rating opens once NetLet is on the App Store. This is a test build.
en.ios.rate.title: Rate our app
en.ios.sell.portalNote: Prices, stock, orders and payouts are managed in the seller portal on the web, with the same account.
en.ios.tooLong: That is too long. Keep it under {max} characters.
en.ios.tutorial.accountBody: Open {profile}, then choose {create}. Enter your name, email and a password, and type the six-digit code we email you. Already have an account? Sign in with your email and password.
en.ios.tutorial.accountTitle: Sign in or create an account
en.ios.tutorial.cartBody: Tap the plus on a product's photo to add it, and tap again for more. Hold a product to preview it. Your items wait in {cart}.
en.ios.tutorial.findBody: Type in the search bar, tap the microphone to say it, or the camera to search with a photo. Or open {categories} to browse every department.
en.ios.tutorial.ordersBody: Pay cash when your order arrives. Follow each parcel from {profile} → {orders}, and return an item within {days} days.
en.ios.tutorial.ordersTitle: Pay at the door, follow every parcel
en.ios.tutorial.skipHint: Closes the tutorial and opens the shop.
en.ios.tutorial.welcomeBody: Shop from many stores at once and pay once, at your door.
en.ios.voice.denied: NetLet cannot use the microphone. Allow it in Settings, under NetLet, or type instead.
en.ios.voice.privacy: Apple's speech recognition turns what you say into text; NetLet gets only the words.
en.ios.voice.unsupported: This phone cannot listen in this language. Type instead.
en.legal.questions: Questions about this page, or about an order, go to Help, where a person reads every message.
en.manufacturer.badUrl: That is not an address NetLet can read. Paste the full address of the product page, starting https://.
en.manufacturer.hint: Paste the address of this product on the maker's own site. NetLet reads the images the maker lists for the product, and you choose which to use.
en.manufacturer.needName: Give the product its name first, so there is something to search for.
en.manufacturer.noneFound: That page lists no product images NetLet can read. Try the product's own page rather than a category or the home page.
en.manufacturer.notAPage: That address is not a web page.
en.manufacturer.notAnImage: That is not an image NetLet can use.
en.manufacturer.notHttps: Only secure pages, starting https://, can be read.
en.manufacturer.rights: Use a maker's images only where they allow sellers to; most do for their own products. NetLet keeps a note of where each one came from.
en.manufacturer.searchFailed: The search did not answer. Try again, or paste the address.
en.manufacturer.searchHint: NetLet searches Google for this product's name and lists the pages it finds. Choose the maker's own one.
en.manufacturer.searchNone: No pages were found for this name. Paste the address instead.
en.manufacturer.searchOff: Searching is not available at the moment. Paste the address instead.
en.manufacturer.tooLarge: That is too large to fetch.
en.manufacturer.tooMany: That is a lot of fetching in an hour. Try again later.
en.manufacturer.tooSmall: Too small to use: under 300 pixels on its shorter side.
en.manufacturer.urlLabel: The manufacturer's page for this product
en.media.aiAlt: The photo made square on white by NetLet AI
en.media.aiClean: Make it square with NetLet AI
en.media.aiNote: Made square on white by NetLet AI (Google's Gemini) from your photo, with the whole product in it. Check the product itself is unchanged — its shape, colour and labels — before you use it.
en.media.chooseTitle: Which version should go on the product?
en.media.copyGone: That photo has changed or was already copied.
en.media.copyTooMany: That is the most photos one account can copy in an hour. Copy the rest later.
en.media.failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Try again.
en.media.fixedAlt: The photo after the automatic fixes
en.media.notAllowed: Only a store's managers can upload product photos.
en.media.notAnImage: That file is not a photo this browser can read.
en.media.nothingToFix: Nothing needed fixing; it has only been resized for the shop.
en.media.nothingToPutBack: There is no earlier photo to put back.
en.media.originalAlt: The image as found on the manufacturer's page
en.media.takenAlt: The photo as you took it
en.media.tooLarge: That photo could not be made small enough to store.
en.media.tooMany: That is a lot of uploads in an hour. Try again later.
en.media.tooSmall: That photo is too small to look sharp on the shop. Use one at least 300 pixels on its shorter side.
en.media.uploaded: Photo added to the list. Press Save under the photos to put it on the product.
en.media.wrongType: That file is not the kind of image it claims to be.
en.membership.adminNote: NetLet membership: free delivery, member prices and first place in the dispatch queue. Buying a membership waits on payments, so for now NetLet grants it — to staff, a pilot group, or a shopper it owes an apology. A member's free delivery is NetLet's cost: each seller's fee stands, and the order records what was waived.
en.membership.badPrice: Enter a whole number of points, 0 to stop selling memberships.
en.membership.benefitDeliveryOver: Free delivery on orders of {amount} or more.
en.membership.benefitPrices: Member prices where a seller offers them, shown on the product and charged at checkout.
en.membership.benefitPriority: Your parcels go first in the queue for the next driver.
en.membership.buyBody: {months} months of membership for {cost} points. The points come off your balance now.
en.membership.deliveryWaived: Free delivery with your membership — you save {amount}.
en.membership.endBody: Benefits stop now. Orders already placed keep their member prices and free delivery — those were part of the sale.
en.membership.freeOverHint: Leave blank for free delivery on every member order. Under this amount a member pays delivery like anybody else.
en.membership.grantNote: By the account's email. A second grant starts when the first ends, so it extends rather than overlaps.
en.membership.memberPriceHint: What NetLet members pay. Blank for none. Shown only to members, and only while your discount permit is valid.
en.membership.notEnoughPoints: You do not have enough points for that.
en.membership.notEnoughPointsLine: Costs {cost} points and you have {points}. Earn more by sharing links and inviting friends.
en.membership.notForSale: Memberships are not for sale at the moment.
en.membership.notFound: That membership was not found, or has already ended.
en.membership.pointsPerMonthLine: {points} points a month, paid from your NetLet points.

en.privacy.changes.title: Changes
en.privacy.choices.body: You can see your details and change your name, phone, password, addresses and language from Your account, and delete your account from Your profile there. Deleting it removes what we hold about you; we keep only what the law requires, such as the invoices of orders you placed.
en.privacy.choices.title: Your choices
en.privacy.cookies.analytics: We count visits with an analytics tool that sets no cookies and does not identify you.
en.privacy.cookies.body: NetLet sets one cookie, to keep you signed in, and no advertising cookies. On the Create account form, Google's reCAPTCHA may set cookies of its own.
en.privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
en.privacy.device.body: Four things are kept only on your device: your recent searches, the products you viewed lately, which products it has already counted as viewed today, and your measurements if you ask the size guide to remember them. The products you viewed are sent with a request for your picks so they can count toward them, and are never stored on our side; you can clear them from the home page.
en.privacy.device.title: What stays on your device
en.privacy.intro: This page explains what NetLet keeps about you, why, and who else sees it. NetLet is run by {operator}.
en.privacy.introPlain: This page explains what NetLet keeps about you, why, and who else sees it.
en.privacy.keep.account: Your account: your name, your email address and your language. Your password is held as a one-way code by our sign-in service, so nobody at NetLet can read it.
en.privacy.keep.faceId: Face ID or Touch ID, if you turn it on in the iPhone app: the public half of a key your iPhone made, the phone's name and when it was last used, so we can check that the phone signing in is yours. Your face and your fingerprint never leave your iPhone, and we never see them. Turn it off on Your profile, or delete your account, and the key goes.
en.privacy.keep.gifts: A gift you take from somebody's list: the name you chose to show them, or none if you stay anonymous, and the order it was bought in. They see that name only once the gift has been delivered, and nobody else sees it.
en.privacy.keep.orders: Your orders: what you bought, the delivery addresses and phone number you gave, and the map pin if you placed one.
en.privacy.keep.profile: Your profile, if you add them: a photo, a phone number, your gender and your birthday. Each is optional and can be removed on Your profile. None of them is shown to a store; the photo is shown to you alone, and the phone number is filled in at checkout as the number the driver calls, and you can change it there.
en.privacy.keep.selling: If you apply to sell: your store's details and the documents you upload, which only you and NetLet's administrators can open.
en.privacy.keep.title: What we keep
en.privacy.keep.views: How often each product's page is opened: one count a product and a day, saying whether it was the app or the website on a phone or a computer, and which part of NetLet it was opened from. Nothing about who opened it is kept, and the store sees only the counts.
en.privacy.keep.writing: What you write to us or to a store — messages, reviews and return requests — the products and lists you save, and the products you keep under Frequently bought with the amount you usually take.
en.privacy.long.body: Your account details for as long as your account is open. Orders and invoices for as long as Kuwaiti law requires a business to keep its records, even after an account is closed.
en.privacy.long.title: How long we keep it
en.privacy.title: Privacy policy
en.privacy.who.ai: When you ask the shop assistant, a product's assistant or the help page a question, or search with a photo, the question or the photo goes to Google's Gemini AI model, through a NetLet service that runs on Cloudflare, with the product's own text where you are on one; your name, email, address and orders do not. When you search by voice, your browser's own speech service hears it.
en.privacy.who.apple: When you continue with Apple, Apple tells NetLet your email — or a private address Apple forwards to, if you chose to hide yours — and, the first time, your name. NetLet never sees your Apple ID password. Deleting your NetLet account also asks Apple to unlink NetLet from your Apple ID.
en.privacy.who.drivers: If you deliver for NetLet, your location is shared only while you switch sharing on, and only with the shopper whose parcel you are carrying.
en.privacy.who.drivingTimes: While a driver shares their location, where they are and the pin on the address they are driving to go to Apple Maps, which answers how long the drive takes in today's traffic. Nothing else goes with them — no name, order or account.
en.privacy.who.email: Our email service (Resend) sends the updates in your NetLet inbox to your email address — your orders, the items you follow, replies to your messages — unless you turn that off in your notifications.
en.privacy.who.google: When you create an account, Google's reCAPTCHA checks that you are not a robot. When you place a pin, the map you choose — Google Maps, Apple Maps or OpenStreetMap — loads in your browser.
en.privacy.who.googleSignIn: When you continue with Google, Google tells NetLet your name and email. NetLet never sees your Google password, and keeps nothing of Google's once you are signed in.
en.privacy.who.phoneSignIn: When you continue with your phone number, the 6-digit code is sent to it by text message through NetLet's SMS provider in Kuwait. Only your number and the code go to them.
en.privacy.who.placeLookup: When you drop a pin, its point — and nothing else about you — goes to OpenStreetMap's address service, and to Apple Maps when the shop has it set up, to read the area, block and street at that spot.
en.privacy.who.sell: We do not sell your information, and we do not share it for advertising.
en.privacy.who.services: The services that run NetLet for us: our hosting (Vercel), and our database and sign-in service (Supabase), which also sends your verification codes and password emails.
en.privacy.who.stores: The stores you order from, and the company delivering for them, see what they need to deliver: your name, address, phone number and the items. In messages and reviews a store sees your first name and initial, never your email.
en.privacy.who.title: Who else sees it
en.privacy.who.tryOn: When you try a product on, the photo of yourself you choose goes, with the product's photo, to Google's Gemini AI model to draw you wearing it. NetLet does not keep your photo or the picture it draws.
en.privacy.why.abuse: To stop fraud and abuse: we count failed sign-ins and some repeated requests by network (IP) address, and keep those counts only for a short time.
en.privacy.why.orders: To take your order and bring it to your door, to show you your account, to answer you when you ask for help, and to issue the invoices the law requires.
en.privacy.why.picked: “Picked for you” uses what you saved, added to your bag and bought on NetLet. Only general interest words leave NetLet for it — never your name, email or orders.
en.privacy.why.title: Why we use it

en.seller.cardBody: Switch to the seller portal for {store}: orders, products and payouts.
en.sellerTerms.commission.frozen: The rate in force when an order is placed is copied onto that order, so a later change never reaches back to sales already made.
en.sellerTerms.commission.rate: NetLet's commission is {commission}% of the price of the goods on each sale, unless a different rate is agreed and recorded on your store. Only NetLet sets or changes it, every change is logged with who made it, and it is not taken on delivery.
en.sellerTerms.commission.title: Commission
en.sellerTerms.conduct.contact: Keep every sale on NetLet. Replies to reviews and the headlines of paid banners may not carry phone numbers, email addresses, links or social media handles, and are refused if they do. Arranging a sale outside NetLet breaks this agreement.
en.sellerTerms.conduct.data: Use a shopper's name, phone number and address only to fulfil their order, and keep them no longer than that needs.
en.sellerTerms.conduct.title: Talking to shoppers
en.sellerTerms.delivery.cancel: If you cannot supply an item, cancel its line before it is paid: its stock goes back, and the shopper is not asked to pay for it.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.damage: Damage in transit is claimed against the delivery company that carried the parcel, which answers before NetLet decides.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.terms: You set your own delivery fee, the order value over which you deliver free, and how fast you ship, and those are what shoppers are charged and shown. Ship each order within the speed you chose, with the delivery company you name.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.title: Delivery
en.sellerTerms.ending.body: You may close your store at any time by asking through Help. NetLet may suspend or close it for a breach of this agreement or of Kuwaiti law.
en.sellerTerms.ending.paid: What you earned on delivered orders that were not refunded is still paid out after a store is suspended or closed.
en.sellerTerms.ending.title: Suspension and closing
en.sellerTerms.intro: This is the agreement between {operator}, which runs NetLet, and the business or person who opens a store on it. It is the text a seller accepts on the selling application, version {version}.
en.sellerTerms.introPlain: This is the agreement between NetLet and the business or person who opens a store on it. It is the text a seller accepts on the selling application, version {version}.
en.sellerTerms.law.changes: NetLet publishes any new version of this agreement on this page, with its date, before it applies.
en.sellerTerms.law.kuwait: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Kuwait, and the courts of Kuwait decide any dispute about it.
en.sellerTerms.law.title: Changes and the law
en.sellerTerms.listings.honest: A listing shows what you are actually selling: your own photographs or ones the maker lets sellers use, an honest description, a price above zero, and, for electronics, the warranty you give.
en.sellerTerms.listings.review: Until NetLet marks your store as trusted, a new listing waits for NetLet to review it before shoppers can see it.
en.sellerTerms.listings.title: Listings
en.sellerTerms.listings.warnings: A listing NetLet turns down counts as a warning. Three warnings suspend the store automatically, which takes every listing off the shop until NetLet reinstates it.
en.sellerTerms.parties.accept: You accept this agreement by ticking it on the selling application. The version you accepted is recorded with the application, so a later version never becomes something you agreed to before it existed.
en.sellerTerms.parties.body: "NetLet" is the marketplace and whoever runs it; "you" are the store — the business, or the person selling under NetLet's licence, named on your application. Shoppers buy from you, and NetLet carries the order between you: the listing, the cart, the cash collected at the door, the invoice and the payout.
en.sellerTerms.parties.title: Who this is between
en.sellerTerms.payouts.deductions: A refund made after a payout comes off your next one. Paid placements, and packing fees when NetLet packs your orders, are deducted the same way, and only for what actually ran or was packed.
en.sellerTerms.payouts.title: Payouts
en.sellerTerms.payouts.when: You are paid the sale less NetLet's commission. Cash collected at the door is paid out {codDays} business days after the driver collects it, counting Sunday to Thursday, by transfer to the account on your store. Every transfer is listed with its bank reference on your payouts page.
en.sellerTerms.placements.body: You may book your products into paid places on the shop. A booking is made against what you have earned, charged only for the days it actually ran, and labelled as sponsored wherever it shows. Home page banners are approved by NetLet before they run.
en.sellerTerms.placements.title: Paid placements
en.sellerTerms.prices.permit: You set your own prices. A struck-through "was" price or a percentage off is shown only while your Ministry of Commerce discount permit is recorded on your store and in date; without one, the product still sells at its price and no saving is shown.
en.sellerTerms.prices.requests: If you take price requests, a request you have not answered within {askDays} days lapses, and a price you agree is held for that shopper for {offerDays} days. A shopper is never charged more than your current price because of an agreed one.
en.sellerTerms.prices.title: Prices and discounts
en.sellerTerms.returns.refund: An accepted return is refunded at the price the item was sold at, or exchanged when you have it in stock.
en.sellerTerms.returns.title: Returns
en.sellerTerms.returns.window: Shoppers may return an item within {days} days of delivery. A damaged, faulty or wrong item, or one not as described, is accepted at once; a change of mind is accepted too, except on groceries and other perishable goods. Anything else is decided by a person.
en.sellerTerms.store.documents: Before a store opens, NetLet checks your trade licence (unless you sell under NetLet's licence), the civil ID of the person signing for the store, and a letter for a bank account in the store's name. Keep them current: an expired licence or a changed account is yours to update.
en.sellerTerms.store.title: Your store
en.sellerTerms.store.yours: You sell your own goods under your store's name, and you are responsible for them being as described, safe and lawful to sell in Kuwait. NetLet issues one invoice per order and names you on it as the seller, with your commercial registration, or says that you sell under NetLet's licence when that is what was agreed.
en.sellerTerms.title: Seller agreement
